items.title: FERC Approves 2027 Budgets for NERC and Regional Entities
items.description: Today, at its monthly open meeting, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) approved the 2027 business plans and budgets for NERC and the Regional Entities, placing the ERO Enterprise in a strong position to address the most urgent reliability and security risks impacting the bulk power system.

items.title: NERC’s Computational Loads Standards Pass Final Ballot, Advance to Board Adoption
items.description: NERC’s foundational Computational Loads Reliability Standards and their associated implementation plans have passed final ballot, marking a significant milestone in an accelerated effort to address emerging reliability risks associated with the rapid growth of large electrical loads, including data centers and artificial intelligence facilities.

items.title: NERC Examines International Blackouts to Strengthen North American Grid Reliability
items.description: As electric grids worldwide undergo significant transformation, a new NERC white paper examines three major international blackouts and identifies critical lessons for strengthening the reliability and resilience of North America’s bulk power system.

items.title: North American Collaboration, Large Loads Standards Key Topics at Board Meeting
items.description: Large loads, standards, and the collaborative relationship between the United States and Canada were the focus on NERC’s first Board meeting in Toronto since 2015.

items.title: Letter to CEOs Outlines Near-Term Actions on Large Loads and Standards Development Process
items.description: NERC recently sent a letter to chief executive officers outlining near-term actions on two initiatives: computational loads and the standards development process.
